text_en: O give thanks to the Lord , for he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever.
text_cn: 亚肋路亚！请众感谢上主，因他宽仁， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: O give thanks to the God of gods, for his steadfast love endures forever.
text_cn: 请众感谢众神中的真神， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: O give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 请众感谢万君中的大君， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: who alone does great wonders, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 惟独他行了伟大的奇能， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: who by understanding made the heavens, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 他以他的智慧创造天穹， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: who spread out the earth on the waters, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 他在诸水上将大地铺陈， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: who made the great lights, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 他创造了极巨大的光明， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: the sun to rule over the day, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 他造了太阳在白昼照临， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: the moon and stars to rule over the night, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 他造月与星使黑夜光明， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: who struck Egypt through their firstborn, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 他击杀了埃及国的首生， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: and brought Israel out from among them, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 他领以色列走出埃及境， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 他伸出手臂施展了大能， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: who divided the Red Sea in two, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 他把红海的水从中剖分， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: and made Israel pass through the midst of it, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 他领以色列人海中步行， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 他淹没法郎军队于海心， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: who led his people through the wilderness, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 他率领百姓在旷野绕行， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: who struck down great kings, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 他严惩了最强悍的国君， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: and killed famous kings, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 他击杀了极强盛的国君， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: Sihon, king of the Amorites, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 他杀死了阿摩黎王息红， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: and Og, king of Bashan, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 他杀死了敖格，巴商之君， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: and gave their land as a heritage, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 他将异民地使选民占领， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: a heritage to his servant Israel, for his steadfast love endures forever.
text_cn: 他使己仆以色列人继承， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: It is he who remembered us in our low estate, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 他怀念了我们遭难的人， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: and rescued us from our foes, for his steadfast love endures forever;
text_cn: 他救拔我们脱离了仇人， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: who gives food to all flesh, for his steadfast love endures forever.
text_cn: 他给一切的生灵供食品， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: O give thanks to the God of heaven, for his steadfast love endures forever.
text_cn: 请众感谢天主上居天庭， 因为他的仁慈永远常存。
